a.lede: The Danish government said the breach of names, addresses, and state-issued ID numbers affects 8 million people, including people living abroad and the deceased.
a.title: Hackers steal 8 million citizens’ records from Danish government database

b.lede: Denmark's Central Population Register (CPR) is warning of a data breach that exposed the personal information of approximately 8.8 million registered individuals. [...]
b.title: Denmark population registry data breach affects 8.8 million people
